Amy (Sales): Hey team — Velvet AI wants a focused POC to validate tail latency under bursty web traffic. They care most about p95/p99 for generation at 256 tokens. Can we run a 2-hour sustained + 10-minute microburst test next Tues?

Devon (Solutions Eng): @Amy (Sales) noted. Target concurrency? Are they using chat-style requests (context ~512 tokens) or short prompts? Also any reqs for private VPC or KMS?

Amy (Sales): They said web chat: typical context 512, gen length 256, avg request size small before gen. Target steady qps ~120 with planned bursts to 800 qps for ~5m. They asked about TLS + BYOK (KMS) for Private.

Mike (Perf): OK. Plan suggestion: 1) 2h steady at 120 QPS -> measure p50/p95/p99, CPU/GPU util, queueing. 2) 3x microbursts (5m) ramping to 800 QPS spaced 20m apart. 3) a 10m soak at 400 QPS mid-run.

Mike (Perf): Quick runbook snippet — k6 script skeleton to reproduce:
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function () {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({
    model: 'rwd-7b-quant',
    prompt: '...sample...',
    max_tokens: 256
  }), { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
  sleep(0.01);
}
```
Change VU count to shape qps. I'll share exact script and rate schedule.

Tara (SRE): Network notes: if we run in-hosted, multi-AZ routing will add cross-AZ latency on bursts. Recommend running Dedicated staging in single AZ to eliminate cross-AZ noise for p99 baseline. Also ensure TLS termination is at the load balancer, not at instance, so we capture true app latency.

Devon (Solutions Eng): For Velvet's BYOK ask — Private + KMS is doable but for POC we'd need an MFA/peering window to set up KMS access. That typically adds 48-72h. Ask prospect if they can accept temporary managed keys for the POC.

Amy (Sales): I'll ask them. Also pricing question landed: they want an estimated burn for the 2h test + reserved slot recommendation for production (monthly). Can you put quick numbers?

Mike (Perf): Rough estimate: the POC run (staging Dedicated single-AZ) ~ 2x A100-equivalent workers for 3h effective runtime to include warmups => ~$1.8k raw infra cost + engineering ops (we bill time). For production at 120 steady + occasional bursts to 800, recommend 8 reserved slots (autoscale to 12 for bursts) — depends on model quantization and KV cache. I'll draft a cost range: $8k-$12k/mo committed. I'll attach model perf curves after the run.

Tara (SRE): Also call out egress/networking: if they route traffic from EU users to us in US region, egress latencies will kill p99. Recommend running POC in their target region.

ops-bot: Scheduled run created: https://runbook.redwood/internal/runs/1768123456-velvet-poc (owners: Mike, Devon, Tara). Run window: 2026-03-31 14:00-17:00 UTC. Please confirm readiness and any infra approvals. :white_check_mark:

Devon (Solutions Eng): I'll prep the prompt-set for quality gating (small eval set) and a warmup cache script to prefill KV entries. Mike — can you validate expected cache hit delta?

Mike (Perf): Yes — with prefix caching we typically see ~30-45% token cost reduction for Velvet-like conversational workloads after warmup. During cold bursts p95 increases ~30-40ms on our 7b quant model. We'll quantify in run.

Amy (Sales): Great. Action items: (1) Amy -> confirm BYOK tolerance with Velvet, (2) Devon -> prompt set + warmup script, (3) Mike -> final k6 schedule + cost estimate, (4) Tara -> infra signoff + AZ choice. Aim to lock infra by EOD Thu.

Tara (SRE): noted. If Velvet insists on BYOK for POC, we'll need PR to security and a 2-day lead.

Amy (Sales): Copy. I'll update customer and push for managed-keys exception for the test.

Devon (Solutions Eng): Quick note — sample curl for single-request latency capture: curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-7b-quant","prompt":"hi","max_tokens":256}'

Mike (Perf): Will add a small headless harness to capture per-token breakdown and tail logs. I'll post results summary here after run (p50/p95/p99, GPU util, error rates, cost-per-1k-tokens).

Amy (Sales): Thanks all — Velvet is eager, will update on BYOK and confirm the run window. :rocket:
